description: This Java source file defines the class ExpressCheckoutEvents which manages PayPal express checkout processes, including setting up checkout, redirecting to PayPal, updating checkout details, retrieving checkout info, and canceling the checkout. It handles the logic for interacting with PayPal via different service calls, manages checkout types, and retrieves configuration settings related to PayPal payment gateway integration.

classes.name: ExpressCheckoutEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods for managing PayPal express checkout process, including setting up express checkout, redirecting to PayPal, updating checkout info, fetching checkout details, executing the checkout, and canceling it. Also determines checkout type based on configuration.

methods.name: setExpressCheckout
methods.description: Initiates the PayPal express checkout process for the current shopping cart, selecting the appropriate service based on checkout type and handling errors.

methods.name: expressCheckoutRedirect
methods.description: Redirects the user to PayPal for express checkout, constructing the URL based on the configured payment gateway and checkout token.

methods.name: expressCheckoutUpdate
methods.description: Updates the checkout session, particularly for the STANDARD checkout type, via a service call.

methods.name: getExpressCheckoutDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details of the express checkout from PayPal, handling errors and updating the request accordingly.

methods.name: doExpressCheckout
methods.description: Performs the actual express checkout operation, calling the appropriate service based on the checkout type.

methods.name: expressCheckoutCancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing PayPal checkout by removing related session attributes.

methods.name: determineCheckoutType
methods.description: Determines whether the current checkout is PAYFLOW, STANDARD, or NONE based on configuration, either from the request context or delegator and product store ID.
